import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int x;
        ModInt() { x = 0; }
        ModInt(long sig) {
            int sigt = (int)(sig % MOD);
            if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD;
            x = sigt;
        }
        int get() { return x; }

        ModInt add(ModInt that) {
            ModInt res = new ModInt(this.x);
            res.x += that.x;
            if (res.x >= MOD) res.x -= MOD;
            return res;
        }

        ModInt sub(ModInt that) {
            ModInt res = new ModInt(this.x);
            res.x += MOD - that.x;
            if (res.x >= MOD) res.x -= MOD;
            return res;
        }

        ModInt mul(ModInt that) {
            return new ModInt((long)this.x * that.x % MOD);
        }

        ModInt addInPlace(ModInt that) {
            this.x += that.x;
            if (this.x >= MOD) this.x -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt subInPlace(ModInt that) {
            this.x += MOD - that.x;
            if (this.x >= MOD) this.x -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt mulInPlace(ModInt that) {
            this.x = (int)((long)this.x * that.x % MOD);
            return this;
        }
    }

    static class Matrix {
        List<List<ModInt>> v;
        List<List<ModInt>> w;

        Matrix() {}

        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            v = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<ModInt> row = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    row.add(new ModInt(0));
                }
                v.add(row);
            }
        }

        int height() { return v.size(); }
        int width() { return v.get(0).size(); }

        ModInt at(int i, int j) { return v.get(i).get(j); }
        void set(int i, int j, ModInt val) { v.get(i).set(j, val); }

        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix A = new Matrix(n, n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                A.set(i, i, new ModInt(1));
            }
            return A;
        }

        static Matrix identity(Matrix A) {
            return identity(A.height());
        }

        Matrix mul(Matrix B) {
            int n = this.height();
            int m = B.width();
            int p = B.height();
            assert p == this.width();

            Matrix result = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    ModInt x = new ModInt(0);
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        x = x.add(this.at(i, k).mul(B.at(k, j)));
                    }
                    result.set(i, j, x);
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        void assign(Matrix other) {
            this.v = new ArrayList<>();
            for (List<ModInt> row : other.v) {
                this.v.add(new ArrayList<>(row));
            }
        }
    }

    static Matrix pow(Matrix t, long k) {
        Matrix A = new Matrix(t.height(), t.width());
        A.assign(t);
        Matrix B = Matrix.identity(t);
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                B = B.mul(A);
            }
            A = A.mul(A);
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return B;
    }

    static Matrix getRotateMatrix(int k, int t) {
        t = ((t % k) + k) % k;
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            A.set(i, (i + t) % k, new ModInt(1));
        }
        A.set(k, k, new ModInt(1));
        A.set(k + 1, k + 1, new ModInt(1));
        A.set(k + 2, k + 2, new ModInt(1));
        return A;
    }

    static Matrix getSingletonMatrix(int k, int j) {
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            if (i != j) {
                ModInt val = A.at(i, i);
                A.set(i, i, val.add(new ModInt(1)));
            }
        }
        A.set(k + 1, k + 1, new ModInt(1));
        A.set(k + 2, k + 2, new ModInt(1));

        ModInt val1 = A.at(k, k + 1);
        A.set(k, k + 1, val1.add(new ModInt(1)));

        ModInt val2 = A.at(j, k + 1);
        A.set(j, k + 1, val2.sub(new ModInt(1)));

        ModInt val3 = A.at(k, k);
        A.set(k, k, val3.add(new ModInt(2)));

        ModInt val4 = A.at(j, k);
        A.set(j, k, val4.sub(new ModInt(1)));

        ModInt val5 = A.at(k, j);
        A.set(k, j, val5.add(new ModInt(1)));

        return A;
    }

    static int s_k(int k, long j) {
        long t = j;
        int u = 0;
        while (t > 0) {
            u = (u + (int)(t % k)) % k;
            t /= k;
        }
        return u;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line;
        while ((line = br.readLine()) != null && !line.trim().isEmpty()) {
            String[] parts = line.split("\\s+");
            long n = Long.parseLong(parts[0]);
            int k = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);

            Matrix b = new Matrix(1, k + 3);
            b.set(0, k, new ModInt(1));
            b.set(0, k + 1, new ModInt(1));
            b.set(0, k + 2, new ModInt(1));

            long powk = 1;
            int digits = 0;
            while (powk <= n / k) {
                powk *= k;
                ++digits;
            }

            List<Matrix> P = new ArrayList<>();
            P.add(getSingletonMatrix(k, 0));
            for (int i = 1; i <= digits; i++) {
                Matrix identity = Matrix.identity(k + 3);
                Matrix current = identity;
                for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                    current = current.mul(P.get(i - 1));
                    current = current.mul(getRotateMatrix(k, -1));
                }
                P.add(current);
            }

            long offset = 0;
            while (powk > 0) {
                int t = (int)((n - offset) / powk);
                for (int j = 0; j < t; j++) {
                    int s = s_k(k, offset);
                    b = b.mul(getRotateMatrix(k, -s));
                    b = b.mul(P.get(digits));
                    b = b.mul(getRotateMatrix(k, s));
                    offset += powk;
                }
                powk /= k;
                --digits;
            }

            System.out.println(b.at(0, k + 1).get());
        }
    }
}
